protocolVersion.description: Sent on every check-in from 1.12 on; agents before 1.12 leave it out. The server keeps a check-in retryable for those (a database error that stops its events fails it), as they count every event delivered on success.

state.description: Compact device-state snapshot (AgentDeviceStateDto): battery, charging, locked, kioskActive, androidRelease, lastBootAt, and optional fields such as agentVersion and powerMode.

events.description: Buffered lifecycle events (TelemetryEventDto) flushed on this check-in, oldest first. The response's eventsAccepted (protocol 1.12) says how many the server consumed; a server without it stores the first 100 and drops the rest, so send at most 100 until a response carries it. A type outside ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ is skipped.

hardwareId.description: The same stable, permission-free device id as on enroll, so an enrolled device can backfill it.
